projects.name: Boquete Country Club
projects.descriptionEn: Boquete Country Club is an exclusive residential community located just five minutes from the town of Boquete. The BCC community sits atop a plateau at an elevation of 3,600 feet, featuring a topography that slopes from north to south; this layout affords every residential lot, condominium, and villa views of the Pacific Ocean and Volcán Barú, as well as spectacular views of both the sunrise and sunset. The Boquete Country Club community will comprise a total of 135 single-family residential lots ranging in size from 1,000 m² to 2,000 m², 18 lots designated for small condominium complexes, and a number of lots allocated for commercial areas to provide basic services to the community. Currently, the infrastructure for the majority of these lots has already been completed.

projects.name: Seaside
projects.descriptionEn:
Discover Seaside, an innovative Condo Suites project designed for investors looking for:

Strategic Location: Calle Uruguay is a central and popular area, close to restaurants, bars and tourist attractions, which attracts tourists and business travelers.

High Demand: The growing influx of tourists and the mobility of executives mean that the demand for short-term rentals is high.

Potential Yield: Short rentals tend to generate higher income compared to long-term rentals, especially in tourist areas.

Urban Growth: The renovation of the area has increased its attractiveness, which can result in a long-term appreciation of the property.

Flexibility: The possibility of using your property during periods without tenants, having a place to relax and unwind.

Infrastructure: The area has good transport links and services, which makes it even more attractive for tenants.
